# Distant mesas (generated by make_env.py).
new
material new Far --base-color 0.388 0.471 0.490 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Mesa0 --size 1 --location 40.000 14.000 3.000
scale 8.000 7.000 6.000
apply --scale
material assign Far
active Mesa0
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Mesa0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
scale 0.82 0.82 1
mode object
add mesh cube --name Mesa1 --size 1 --location 44.000 -3.000 4.000
scale 9.000 8.000 8.000
apply --scale
material assign Far
active Mesa1
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Mesa1
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
scale 0.82 0.82 1
mode object
add mesh cube --name Mesa2 --size 1 --location 38.000 -15.000 2.250
scale 6.000 6.000 4.500
apply --scale
material assign Far
active Mesa2
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Mesa2
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
scale 0.82 0.82 1
mode object
add mesh cube --name Mesa3 --size 1 --location 47.000 4.000 1.750
scale 6.000 5.000 3.500
apply --scale
material assign Far
active Mesa3
mode edit
select face where "normal.x > 0.5 || abs(normal.y) > 0.5 || normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
active Mesa3
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.5"
scale 0.82 0.82 1
mode object
select all
shade flat
export mesas.glb
